name: Ollama
short: Ollama Cloud hosts open models behind an OpenAI-compatible API, with a free plan that includes starter usage credits; local inference stays free and unlimited.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Pay per token for every cloud model with purchased usage credits; run models locally free and unlimited; 3 concurrent requests; no subscription, no service fees. Off-peak rates apply outside 12:00-18:00 UTC on weekdays and all day on weekends (e.g. deepseek-v4.1-flash $0.15/$0.60 off-peak).

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $60 of usage credits per month (resets monthly, no rollover), 3 concurrent requests and access to larger pro models; Fast mode coming soon.

plans.name: Max
plans.notes: $300 of usage credits per month, 10 concurrent requests and early access to the newest models.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Unlimited users, $1,000 of shared usage credits per month, centralized billing and administration, and priority support.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Volume pricing, model access controls, cost budgets and a private support channel.
